faq.question: Is every product shown in Fashion Battles available to buy?
faq.answer: No. A featured product can be bought through LookBerry where it is listed. Not every product shown is necessarily available.

faq.question: How does the marketplace earn commission?
What do Attraction Likes and Style Likes refer to?
faq.answer: Attraction Likes are for the model; Style Likes are for the look. A purchase carries more voting weight than a like alone. The strategy does not confirm a weighting ratio.

faq.question: Does taking part guarantee reach, engagement or sales?
faq.answer: No. Participation guarantees no reach, engagement or sales.
